interface.name: Mode
interface.description: Used to switch the production line between manual and automatic modes, 0 = manual mode, 1 = automatic mode

interface.name: SensorFeed
interface.description: Sensor at the material loading station detecting the arrival of materials

interface.name: SensorWash
interface.description: Sensor at the cleaning station detecting the arrival of materials

interface.name: SensorWeight
interface.description: Sensor at the weighing station detecting the arrival of materials

interface.name: SensorFiring
interface.description: Sensor at the firing station detecting the arrival of materials

interface.name: SensorOutput
interface.description: Sensor at the finished product station detecting the arrival of products

interface.name: CompletionLight
interface.description: Indicator light for product processing completion

scan_semantics: Inputs I[k] are sampled at invocation; outputs O[k] are observed after the call. Retained pre-state q[k] becomes q[k+1]. Each test resets the instance. A transition affects the same observed scan. dt_ms is elapsed time since the preceding invocation; the first invocation starts IEC timers at elapsed zero. CycleTime inputs, where supplied, are attributed to the current invocation rather than inferred from dt_ms.
safety_priority: Forward and reverse are mutually exclusive.
Unqualified weight never proceeds to firing.
Completion commands from an unrelated station are ignored.
assumptions: Manual opposing requests both inhibit the motor. Entering manual clears sequence, kick and completion but retains the last firing setpoint.
Only one product is processed; the caller does not assert contradictory station sensors.
Mode changes reset the automatic route to WAIT_FEED. Confirmations are levels accepted only in their corresponding processing wait.
Arrival has priority; a confirmation already TRUE on the arrival invocation is accepted no earlier than the next invocation.
A rejected item remains at the weighing station, with kick TRUE, until SensorWeight becomes FALSE. It then returns to WAIT_FEED.
firingTemp updates only for accepted weight and retains the last accepted value otherwise. REAL comparisons use absolute tolerance 1e-5.
At most one phase transition occurs per invocation. Output arrival sets CompletionLight immediately, removal clears it and resets the route.

formal_properties.name: Manual
formal_properties.explanation: Manual commands follow level inputs with neutral conflict handling.

formal_properties.name: Arrival stop
formal_properties.explanation: An arrived item stops before processing.

formal_properties.name: Weight decision
formal_properties.explanation: The acceptance interval is inclusive and its setpoint is linear.

formal_properties.name: Setpoint retention
formal_properties.explanation: No unqualified or unrelated scan changes the last accepted setpoint.

formal_properties.name: Completion
formal_properties.explanation: Output arrival and removal control the light.

formal_properties.name: Route
formal_properties.explanation: Only the ordered processing route advances qualified products.

formal_properties.name: Conditional completion
formal_properties.formula: (G(auto) & G(arrival_pending -> F arrival) & G(processing_wait -> F matching_completion) & G(judged -> valid)) -> G(feed -> F light)
formal_properties.explanation: With continuing automatic mode, eventual movement/processing feedback and accepted weights, each feed eventually completes.

atomic_propositions.arrival: pre-phase moving AND corresponding destination sensor TRUE
atomic_propositions.judged: auto AND pre-phase WAIT_WEIGHT AND SensorWeight AND weightComplete
atomic_propositions.qualified: NOT kick AND fwd AND firingTemp=500+(weight-100)*0.5
atomic_propositions.output_arrival: auto AND pre-phase MOVE_TO_OUTPUT AND SensorOutput
atomic_propositions.removed: auto AND pre-phase OUTPUT_DONE AND NOT SensorOutput
atomic_propositions.processing_wait: pre-phase is WAIT_WASH, WAIT_WEIGHT or WAIT_FIRING
atomic_propositions.matching_completion: matching station sensor and processing completion are TRUE in the corresponding wait
atomic_propositions.order: automatic route is FEED, WASH, WEIGHT, FIRING, OUTPUT; rejected weights cannot enter FIRING
